description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the JobCategoryDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin Plugin. It sets up test data, runs assertions to verify behavior of methods like getJobCategoryList() and getJobCategoryById(), and is part of the test suite for the DAO layer of the HR management system.

classes.name: JobCategoryDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the JobCategoryDao data access object related to job categories in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, including creating an instance of JobCategoryDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests if the DAO correctly returns a list of job categories, expected to contain 3 entries.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests if retrieving a job category by ID returns the expected name.
